Darwaza khola... ek bulb jal raha tha. Par baaki do? Kaunsa kiska... pata hi nahi. Galat jawaab!

Ye puzzle MakeMyTrip aur Qualcomm jaise companies ke interview mein poocha gaya hai. Bahar teen switch. Andar teen bulb. Har switch, ek bulb ka. Aur candidate ho... tum. Switch jitni baar chaho, on-off karo. Par kamre mein, sirf ek baar ja sakte ho.
Toh batao... kaunsa switch, kaunsa bulb? Teen second... socho.

Trick hai, bulb ki garmi! Pehla switch on karo, das minute ruko. Phir use off karo, doosra on karo, aur andar jao. Jalta bulb, doosre switch ka. Bujha par garam, pehle ka. Bujha aur thanda, teesre ka!
Solve kar liya? Comment mein batao. Aise puzzles ke liye, follow karo pretestpassed dot codes.
